Definition: from G3844 and G2523; to sit down near:--sit.
BiblicalUsage: Parakathizō means to sit down beside, to sit at one's feet. Mary sits at Jesus' feet and hears His word, while her sister Martha is cumbered about much serving.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that sitting is the better part: Martha serves and is careful, but Mary sits and listens, and Jesus says her part shall not be taken away.
